description: The pie chart illustrates the win rates (%) of three language models—GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral—when evaluated on their ability to generate empathetic responses, as assessed by Gemini. The chart is divided into three distinct segments, each representing one model's performance. GPT-4o is shown with a win rate of 19.6%, represented by a dark blue segment. LLaMA has a significantly higher win rate of 80.4%, depicted by a light blue segment that occupies the majority of the chart. Mistral achieves a win rate of 88.0%, indicated by a red segment. The labels and corresponding percentages are clearly marked with lines pointing to their respective slices, and the chart includes a central label reading "Win rate (%)". The segments are arranged in a circular format, with the largest slice (Mistral) positioned at the bottom right, followed by LLaMA, and GPT-4o at the top left.
